Īśvaradīkṣita
of Kauṇḍinya gotra; son of Varadarājasūri; wrote when Kṛṣṇadevarāya was ruling a. --C. Rāmāyaṇasārasaṅgraha or Īśvaradīkṣitīya, Laghuvivaraṇa. MD. 17148.
--C. D.., Bṛhadvivaraṇa. MD. 15890. See MT. 4773 post-col. verses here, 2, 4, 5. Verse 3 gives the date of composition a. 1517 A. D. Verse 7 ascribes Laghu an. Bṛhad Vivaraṇas to Īśvara; verses 4, 5 mention his son Śrīnivāsa a. a. of the Bṛhad viº.
For other Mss. not known a. Laghu or Bṛhadvivaraṇa, see MT. 3500 (a.. 3804 (c). 5781. 6500. Also TCD. 206. 216. TD. 9471-80.

Pt.. Text an. C., K. M. Gucch. IX.

Īśvaraśarman
native of Bimbali or Vaṭakkumkūr, a principality in Kerala, an. student of a Brahman of Vyāghraveśman, (Puliyannūr ?).
--Śṛṅgārasundarabhāṇa. GD. 1596-97. Granthappura p. 79 (1596-97).

Īśvaraśāstrin
one of the a.s mentioned in the Nṛsiṁhasarvasva. RASB. IV. 3108 (p. 82).

Īśvaraśāstrin
--Agnyādhānasāmakārikā. PUL. II. App. p. 20 (2 mss.).
--Ūrdhvadeha (Aurdhvadehika) prayoga. Jaiminīya. PUL. II. App. 32.

Īśvaraśiva
preceptor of Hṛdayaśiva, a. of Prāyaścittasamuccaya. He belonged to the school of Raṇipatra Lambakarṇa of Mattamayūravaṁśa. Nepal I. p. 215. See also Nepal I. Pref. p. lxvi.

Īśvaraśiva
alias somezvara; śaiva teacher; son of Śrīkaṇṭhaśambhu; guru of the Col. king, Kulottuṅga III (A. D. 1178-1260).
--Siddhāntaratnākara. Epi. Rep. Madras 1908 (1907-8) p. 68. The Rep. suggests his identity with Īśānaśiva, a. of Siddhāntasāra.

Īśvarasaṃhitā
Pañcarātrāgama. Gov. Or. Libr. Madras 11. IM. 11009. MD. 5208 [Page279-a. (inc.). Mysore I. p. 592. Oppert II. 3972. R. A. Sastri I. p. 127.
--C. Vyākhyā Sātvatārthaprakāśikā by Alaśiṅgabhaṭṭa (A. D. 1836). Adyar II. p. 180a. Mysore I. p. 592. Oppert II. 3973 (a..). R. A. Sastri IV. 268. Used in the compilation of Prāyaścittasaṅgraha, MT. 3743 an. Sāttvatāmṛta, MT. 784. Q. by Gomaṭharaṅganātha in his C. on Śrīsūkta, MD. 25.
Pt.. (1) Mysore 1890 (?). (2) Śāstramuktāvalī 45, Conjeevaram, 1921.

Īśvarasaṃhitā(nṛsiṃhakalpa)
Īśvara-Pārvatīsaṁvāda, Pañcarātra; 14 chs. Different from ptd. work noted above. R. A. Sastri II. 169. IV. 267. Same work in Baroda ms. 7967.

Īśvarasahasranāma
stotra. from Mārkaṇḍeyapurāṇa. Mad. Uni. R. K. S. 111 (b).

Īśvarasādhanadūṣaṇa
or Īśvaradūṣaṇa by Ratnakīrti. Pt.. p.. 29-52, Ratnakīrtinibandhāvalī K. P. Jayaswal Res. Inst. Patna, 1957. See also ib. p. 16, Text.

Īśvarasiṃha
son of Sevai Jaising of Jaipur (18th cent.). Kṛṣṇakavi wrote his Īśvaravilāsakāvya a. his instance. See P. K. Gode, Studies in Ind. Lit. His.., II. p. 289. See also BORI. D. XVI. i. 11.

Īśvarasiddhi
viś. adv. one section of the Siddhitraya. by Yāmunācārya. Oppert II. 1034. See Siddhitraya.

Īśvarasiddhi
Kaś. Śai. with a.'s. C.s. by Utpaladeva. One section of the Siddhitrayī of Utpaladeva. Text has gaps.
Ed.. Kas. Texts 34. no. ii.

Īśvarasukhavāda
ny. by Gopālatātācārya. Oppert I. 7858.

Īśvarasumati
--Pārvatīpariṇayakāvya. Burnell 159b. TD. 3694. [Page279-b]

Īśvarasūktimālā
śaiva. Śṛṅgerī Mutt 12 (1). Is it Śrutisūktimālā ?

Īśvarasūri
teacher of the a.. a. of Asiddhavatsūtravicāra. gr. (Adyar D. VI. 432).

Īśvarasūri
or Ī. ācārya. Jain.
--Jīvavicāravṛtti. B. IV. 52 (with C.). BORI. 699 of 1892-95. Leumann 60. Peters. V. p. 285.
--C. Vṛtti by a himself. B. IV. 52. Jainagranthāvalī p. 123. Leumann 60.

Īśvarasūri
father of Makkibhaṭṭa or Hemādribhaṭṭa (a. of C. Darpaṇa on Raghuvaṁśa, Adyar D. V. 290. BORI. D. XIII. i. 591. MT. 3766.)

Īśvarasūri
Jain. pupil of Śāntisūri of Sandera Gaccha.
--Lalitāṅgacaritra. Pattan I. Intro. p. 68. The a. wrote also Sāgaradatta Rāsa in the reign of Mulikamafar of Malwa.

Īśvarasūri
or Īśvarabhaṭṭopādhyāya. Inscriptional poet, (Corpus of inscription in Teliṅgaṇa, Nos. 51 an. 52). See J. of the Ori. Inst., M. S. Uni., Baroda VII. p. 79.

Īśvarasena
med. authority mentioned by Vijayarakṣita in his C. Madhukośa on Rugviniścaya (IO. 2668). Said to have written a C. on Caraksaṁhitā, see Āyurved kā Itihās, p. 300.

Īśvarasena
a logician. Q. in a. unidentified Bud. Nyā. fr. RASB. I. 33 (p. 31). Q. also in Durveka's Dharmottarapradīpa, Patna edn. p.. 103, 108. C.. Īśvarasena said to be Diṅnāga's pupil an. teacher of Dharmakīrti in Diṅnāga's Pramāṇasamuccaya, S. C. Vidyabhushan, HIL. p. 309. See also JUPHS. XVII. ii. p. 29.

Īśvarastuti
TD. 22190-91.

Īśvarastuti
from Kāśīkhaṇḍa. Burnell 202a. [Page280-a.

--from M. Bhārata, Karṇaparvan (ch. 33). Burnell 202a. Taylor I. 482.

Īśvarastotra

Īśvarasvāmin

Īśvarācārya

Īśvarācārya
--Govardhanaprāyaścitta. SSPC. III. T. 45.

Īśvarācārya
Jain.
--C. on Vicāraṣaṭtriṁśikā of Gajasāra. BORI. 1415 of 1891-95.

Mīm. Vid. 208.

Īśvarādhvarin
of Kauṇḍinyagotra, father of Varadārya, a. of Kāmānanda. MT. 2727 (b).

Īśvarānanda
pupil of Satyānanda.
--Mahābhāṣyapradīpavivaraṇa. Wrote Laghu an. Bṛhad Vivaraṇas, MT. 3894, 3866 (a., in each of which one Col. gives Īśvarānanda a. a.; in other places a. given a. Rāmacandra Sarasvatī. BORI. D. XI. i. 57, 58. IO. 589. Weber 727.

Īśvarābhisandhi
by Śrīharṣa, who refers to it in his Khaṇḍana Khaṇḍakhādya (Chowk. edn. p.. 107, 1041, 1132, 1322 & 1325). The commentator Vidyāsāgara quotes extracts from it (ib. p.. 112 an. 1132). IHQ. 1946. vol. XXII. p. 149 & fn.

Īśvarārcana
